scope: Flow-based detector for volumetric and scanning behavior. Not a general NIDS. Botnet, web attacks, infiltration, zero-day, and blocking are out of scope.

inputs.threshold_rule: K = ceil(B * N / 10000); if K >= N, min(score)-epsilon; otherwise score at descending rank K+1

label_policy.missing_policy: removed by the frozen loader; never treated as negative

fanout.reason: Tier B requires raw packets or a stateful aggregator. The repository contains per-flow CSV exports and no .pcap/.pcapng files, so 60-second destination fan-out cannot be derived. It is not approximated from per-flow columns.

syn_tie_diagnostic.explanation: The top SYN score is tied across more rows than either budget allows. The specified tie rule raises the threshold above the maximum and selects zero alerts. This is a property of the rule, not a bug.

notes: Thresholds are selected on validation only; the test partition is loaded after they are frozen.
The decision is score > threshold, so a threshold at descending rank K+1 yields K alerts without ties.
Ties at the boundary reduce the alert count. A top score tied more than K times yields zero alerts.
Rate repairs replace non-finite or negative values with total/duration, or total*1e6 when duration is zero.
Excluded labels are removed from primary metrics and logged as diagnostics.
Tier B fan-out is unavailable because no raw packets exist; it is not approximated from per-flow columns.
Bootstrap intervals resample the thresholded indicator within each class; this is the non-parametric bootstrap distribution of TP/FP at a frozen threshold.
The test partition is CIC-IDS-2017 Thursday + Friday, already inspected. It is not a blind confirmatory test.
These are rule baselines, not a deployable detector. Detection remains 4/10.
